summary: Tiffany Mountain's 1931 eight-foot pole lookout, staffed into the late 1930s, was removed or destroyed in 1953; no source describes remains on the summit.

facts.design: 8-foot pole tower with gable-roofed L-4 cab (built 1931)
facts.status_note: Removed or destroyed in 1953; the sources disagree on which, and none describes remains on the summit.

access.note: Reached by Forest Service roads and a signed trail that starts at a pass.

visit.trail_note: Forest roads to a pass, then the Freezeout Pass Trail No. 345. Willhite lists 2 miles and 1,700 ft of gain but also puts a trail junction at 2.5 miles.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in 1953; FirelookOut and the trip report say destroyed in 1953; Willhite says removed or destroyed. All four agree on the year, so the story reports both words.

sources.title: Tiffany Mountain Lookout Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites register, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: The 1930 lookout predates the 1931 tower and Willhite does not explain the gap, so the story reports both without comment. Willhite's hike distance (2 miles) conflicts with its own trail junction at 2.5 miles. Summit elevation is 8,242 ft in the register and FirelookOut but 8,245 ft in Willhite; not used in the story. The trip report is a personal account, used only for the 1931/1953 dates and the summit description. The Washington lookout list page was not fetched for this site. No reusable photos with licence were found.
